summary: Seadrill Ltd filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No. 2 to its Senior Secured Revolving Credit Agreement, dated June 16, 2026. The amendment increases revolving commitments from $225 million to $300 million, extends maturity from 2028 to 2031, removes certain immaterial subsidiaries as guarantors and stacked vessels as collateral, modifies commitment fees, and eases restrictive covenants to provide operational flexibility. The borrower is Seadrill Finance Limited; the issuer is Seadrill Ltd. J.P. Morgan SE acts as predecessor administrative agent with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as successor and GLAS Trust as security agent. Effectiveness is expected June 30, 2026, subject to conditions. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation.
